name: Studio Product Commercial
visual_style: Premium product commercial with faithful shape, materials, finish, branding and realistic fine surface details.
camera: Precise controlled orbit, macro detail or smooth studio dolly that reveals product features.
lighting: Softbox reflections, refined rim lights and controlled studio contrast.
motion: Slow precise movement; preserve product dimensions, parts and details.
consistency: Maintain subject identity, geometry, wardrobe, environment and all distinctive details across frames. Avoid morphing, duplicate limbs, unwanted object changes and camera jumps.
negative_guidance: Avoid flicker, temporal inconsistency, deformations, unnatural body motion, random text, unintended logos and watermarks.
